question: Which of the following is a non-conventional source of energy?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Solar energy.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Solar energy **is a **renewable** and **non-polluting **source of energy that is obtained from the sun's radiation.
 
• It is a **non-conventional source** of energy because it is not derived from the traditional sources of energy like coal, oil, and natural gas.
 
• Solar energy can be harnessed through the use of **solar panels,** which convert the sun's radiation into electricity.
 
• Solar energy is an **abundant source of energy** and has the potential to meet the world's energy needs in the future.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Crude oil** is a **conventional source **of energy that is obtained from the ground.

 
 
• It is a **non-renewable** and** polluting source** of energy that is responsible for air pollution and greenhouse gas emissions.
 
 
 
• **Natural gas** is also a **conventional source** of energy that is obtained from the ground.
 
 
• It is a **non-renewable source** of energy that is **cleaner than coal and oil **but still contributes to greenhouse gas emissions.
 
 
 
• **Coal** is a **conventional source** of energy that is obtained from the ground.
 
 
• It is a non-renewable and polluting source of energy that is responsible for air pollution and** greenhouse gas emissions.**
